news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses one kick Sunday
news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 2-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Aubrey didn't have a good night on Sunday night. He scored just two points in the team's loss to New York, and he even missed one of his extra-point attempts late in the game. He should bounce back and return to being a good fantasy option sometime in the near future.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey signs four-year extension with Cowboys
news.body: The Cowboys signed K Brandon Aubrey to a four-year, $28 million contract extension.
news.impact: Aubrey becomes the first kicker to ever earn $7 million per year and receive $20 million guaranteed. He has established himself as the top kicker in the NFL.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign offer sheet with another team
news.body: Cowboys restricted free agent kicker Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign an offer sheet with another team.
news.impact: If Aubrey does not sign an offer sheet with another team by Friday, Dallas retains his rights for the 2026 season. He appears likely to remain with the Cowboys.

news.head: Brandon Aubrey says he wants to sign extension with Cowboys
news.body: Brandon Aubrey said he wants to sign a contract extension with the Cowboys.
news.impact: Aubrey added that "something will happen eventually.” The Cowboys placed a second-round tender on Aubrey that would pay him $5.76 million in 2026 after the two sides couldn't come to an agreement on an extension.

news.head: D'Andre Swift rushes for three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers
news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 18 times for 124 rushing yards and three touchdowns while also catching his lone target for 10 yards in the Bears' 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.impact: Swift led an impactful Chicago backfield attack in the season opener for head coach Ben Johnson, averaging 6.9 yards per carry in the win. The veteran running back will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 2 for fantasy managers.

news.head: D'Andre Swift agrees to three-year extension with Bears
news.body: D'Andre Swift and the Bears agreed to terms on a three year, $33.75 million extension with $27.5M in guaranteed money.
news.impact: The Bears continue to show their commitment to Swift, this time to the tune of a three year, $33.75 million extension right before the start of the regular season. This move dispels many of the concerns that Kyle Monangai would take over this backfield in the near future. Chicago continues to display high trust in their veteran running back, and he seems to be primed for a big year in 2026 so long as he can stay healthy.

news.head: D'Andre Swift (core) without injury designation for Sunday
news.body: D'Andre Swift (core) is without an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
news.impact: Swift will be able to play in the team's season opener on Sunday. He was recently battling through an issue with his core, but it's nothing more than a minor injury and shouldn't hinder him against the Panthers. He's expected to be a good fantasy option for as long as he can remain healthy and in the lineup for Chicago.

news.head: D'Andre Swift at practice Monday
news.body: D'Andre Swift was present at practice on Monday.
news.impact: Swift left practice early last week due to what was reported to be a cramp. His presence at practice on Monday is a good sign for his status heading into this week's season opener.

news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) out at least six weeks
news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to miss at least six weeks for the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
news.impact: Brown was placed on injured reserve after suffering the ankle injury in New England’s Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks Wednesday night, leaving head coach Mike Vrable without his top pass-catching option for the foreseeable future. In the wideout’s absence Mack Hollins, Romeo Doubs, and DeMario Douglas will need to step up for quarterback Drake Maye early in the season.

news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) placed on injured reserve
news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) has been placed on injured reserve by the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.

news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) expect to miss at least four weeks
news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to miss at least four weeks with a high ankle sprain that he sustained early in the third quarter of the Patriots game against the Seahawks on Wednesday night.
news.impact: It’s a big blow to Brown’s Fantasy stock to start the season. In his absence, expect Hunter Henry and Romeo Doubs to see more work. However, with Doubs was struggling to find snaps and catch the ball, it’s possible that Demario Douglas could be a nice PPR sleeper.

news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) believed to have suffered high-ankle sprain on Wednesday
news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in last nights game against the Seahawks. He will have an MRI today to determine the extent of the injury and how much time he will miss.
news.impact: It’s a tough start to Browns Patriot tenure. He went down early in the third quarter and did not return, leaving Drake Maye to lean on Hunter Henry, Demario Douglas, and Mack Hollins with fellow newcomer Romeo Doubs struggling to catch anything. Doubs should bounce back, and if Brown is out for any period of time, expect Doubs and Henry to have some more fantasy appeal, with Douglas as a PPR dart throw in deep formats.

news.head: Jason Myers scores seven points in win Wednesday
news.body: Jason Myers went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Myers did his job on Wednesday, knocking in all three of his kicks en route to a win over the Patriots. He will likely be a decent fantasy option at the position over the course of the season, assuming QB Sam Darnold (hip) doesn't miss significant time and leave the offense weaker moving forward.

news.head: Jason Myers has rare off night Saturday
news.body: Jason Myers missed two field goal attempts on Saturday night but the Seahawks still managed a 13-3 win over San Francisco to clinch the top seed in the NFC.
news.impact: Myers had made 18 straight field goal attempts before his miss from 47 yards out early in the second quarter. He also missed on Seattle's last drive of the game when he hit the right upright from 26 yards away. Myers did have makes of 45 yards and 31 yards and also converted his only extra point attempt. Myers finishes with career highs in field goals made (41) and field goal attempts (48) while also converting a perfect 48-of-48 on PATs.

news.head: Jason Myers connects on five kicks Sunday
news.body: Jason Myers connected on both of his field goal attempts and all three extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Myers remains one of the top kickers in the NFL this season. He is 39-of-44 on field goals this year.

news.head: Jason Myers quiet in Seahawks OT win over Rams Thursday
news.body: After his historic six-field goal performance in Seattle's Week 15 win over the Colts, Jason Myers was not a factor in the Seahawks' 38-37 overtime win over the Rams on Thursday night. Myers did not attempt a field goal and converted both point after attempts in the Week 16 thriller.
news.impact: While Myers' performance could not have come at a worse time for fantasy owners vying for league titles, this was certainly a game script issue. With Seattle trailing 30-14 in the fourth quarter, the Seahawks could not afford to settle for field goals - or even PATs - during their rally. Myers was left on the sidelines as Seattle converted three straight two-point tries in the fourth quarter and OT. Myers entered having connected on at least three field goal attempts in six straight games and he still leads the NFL with 155 points. For those Myers owners fortunate enough to advance, expect him to bounce back in Week 17 against the Panthers.

news.head: Steelers D/ST scores TD in Week 1 win
news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 13 points while scoring a touchdown, forcing two turnovers, and notching four sacks in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.impact: Pittsburgh took advantage of the Falcons being forced to start their third-string QB in Cooper Rush. T.J. Watt dominated the whole afternoon as he sealed the game with a 35-yard pick-six in the fourth quarter while also logging two sacks. The Steelers will have a tougher test in Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.head: Steelers hiring Mike McCarthy as head coach
news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers are working on a deal to sign Mike McCarthy as the organization's next head coach.
news.impact: McCarthy will succeed Mike Tomlin as the head man for the Steelers. Like Tomlin, McCarthy is one of the winningest coaches in NFL history, with a career record of 60.8% and 174 wins (15th). The Steelers value stability, and McCarthy brings that, along with ties to the city.

news.head: Steelers head coach Mike Tomlin stepping down
news.body: After 19 seasons at the helm of the Pittsburgh Steelers, head coach Mike Tomlin is stepping down as the Steel City’s head man.
news.impact: Tomlin was the longest-tenured active head coach in the NFL for one of the steadiest organizations in the league. The Steelers have had just three coaches since 1969, becoming a pillar of institutional stability. Tomlin never had a losing record as a head coach. However, after failing to win a playoff game since 2016, the Super Bowl champion head coach has informed the organization that he will step down, which will heavily impact Pittsburgh’s offseason plans.

news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 24 points in Week 18 win
news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 24 points while notching three sacks and forcing one turnover in a 26-24 win over the Ravens in Week 18.
news.impact: The Steelers played just well enough to knock off the Ravens. They were boosted by the return of T.J. Watt from injury. Pittsburgh will now host the Texans in the Wild-Card round of the playoffs while the Ravens will go home.

news.head: Texans defense struggles to contain Bills in Week 1
news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 36 points on 409 yards of total offense while coming up with two sacks and no takeaways in Sunday's loss to the Bills.
news.impact: The Texans should feature a solid defensive unit this season, but they ran into a potent Bills' offense in Week 1. Powered by QB Josh Allen, the Bills shredded the Texans' pass defense, totaling 334 yards and a couple of scores through the air. Houston did come up with a couple of sacks, but Allen mostly had his way. The Texans will face another top-tier QB when Joe Burrow and the Bengals visit Houston in Week 2.

news.head: Texans D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 30 points on 354 total yards with one interception, one sack and fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Colts.
news.impact: Houston sat its starters in the second half. They remain one of the top defenses in the NFL. They'll take on Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers in the Wild Card round.

news.head: Houston Texans D/ST force three turnovers in win
news.body: The Houston Texans D/ST forced two fumbles, an interception, and racked up five sacks in the Texans' 20-16 win over the Chargers.
news.impact: The Texans put up a dominant performance once again, showing why they are one of the best units in the league. Both star linemen Danielle Hunter and Will Anderson added sacks to their impressive season totals in the win. They're on a hot streak entering the final week of the NFL regular season.

news.head: Texans D/ST scores touchdown in win Sunday
news.body: The Texans' D/ST logged three sacks, one interception, and one touchdown while allowing 21 points in Sunday's win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.impact: Houston's defense was slightly disappointing on Sunday by allowing Las Vegas' dismal offense to score 21 points, but they were able to make up for that by scoring a pick-six early on in the game. This is one of the league's best units and should continue to play pretty well for the remainder of the regular season.

news.head: Rico Dowdle quiet in Week 1 win
news.body: Rico Dowdle carried the ball eight times for 15 yards and caught two of his five targets for six yards in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.impact: Dowdle and Jaylen Warren split the backfield with Warren racking up more all-purpose yards (73 to 21) and seeing five more touches. Dowdle will continue to have fantasy value as he's proven in past years that he can be a difference-maker, but he should be on fantasy benches heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Patriots.

news.head: Rico Dowdle, Jaylen Warren both see first-team reps Thursday
news.body: Rico Dowdle and Jaylen Warren split the first-team reps in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Dowdle and Warren continue to rotate who sees the first reps with the first-team. They are likely to both be involved in a committee in the Steelers backfield this season.

news.head: Rico Dowdle signing with Steelers
news.body: Free agent running back Rico Dowdle is signing with the Pittsburgh Steelers according to multiple reports.
news.impact: Dowdle is coming off of a second consecutive 1,000-yard rushing season as he totaled 1,076 yards and a career-high six touchdowns with the Carolina Panthers. He finished four yards shy of surpassing his career-high of 1,079 yards in his final season with Dallas in 2024. Dowdle has played five seasons in the NFL and has carried the ball 567 times - but 471 of those have come in the last two seasons. He'll be the new running mate to Jaylen Warren in the Steelers' backfield in 2026.

news.head: Rico Dowdle linked to Commanders
news.body: The Commanders have been linked to free agent RB Rico Dowdle.
news.impact: Washington is likely to add in a running back this offseason, whether it be in free agency or the NFL Draft. Dowdle could end up being a fairly affordable option for them.

news.head: George Pickens held to 28 yards Sunday
news.body: George Pickens caught 3-of-6 targets for just 28 yards in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Pickens had an extremely disappointing start to the season on Sunday night. He was held to just 28 yards on three catches in the team's first game of the season after being hyped up as an elite fantasy prospect throughout the preseason. He should bounce back and play better than this moving forward, but his week-to-week floor may be lower than some realize if Dallas' offense struggles with consistency this season.

news.head: George Pickens to play 2026 season on franchise tag with Cowboys
news.body: George Pickens will officially play the 2026 season on a $27.3 million franchise tag for the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Pickens and the Cowboys could not agree upon a long-term extension this summer, so he will head into the year effectively on a 1-year deal. The wideout is coming off a career year in which he hauled in 93 catches for 1,429 yards and nine touchdowns. He will head into this season with Dallas firmly in the WR1 conversation in fantasy.

news.head: George Pickens expected to move around formation more this season
news.body: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he plans to move WR George Pickens around the formation more this season.
news.impact: Pickens has reported to mandatory minicamp after sitting out of voluntary OTAs. He is expected to play both on the outside and in the slot, adding to the versatility he will offer the Cowboys offense.

news.head: George Pickens goes through individual drills in practice Wednesday
news.body: George Pickens went through individual drills on Day 2 of Cowboys minicamp on Wednesday.
news.impact: Pickens reported on Tuesday for the start of mandatory minicamp. He is expected to be a full-go in practice by training camp.

news.head: Saquon Barkley leads backfield attack in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.body: Saquon Barkley carried the ball 15 times for 83 yards while also catching one of his two targets for a loss of three yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Barkley made the most of what the Washington defense gave him, averaging 5.5 yards per carry in the win. The running back will look to offer fantasy managers a dynamic RB1 option in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Saquon Barkley likely to rest in season finale
news.body: The Eagles may sit RB Saquon Barkley in Week 18 against the Commanders.
news.impact: Philadelphia is expected to rest its starters in Week 18, potentially including Barkley. The 28-year-old has rushed for 1,140 yards and scored nine total touchdowns this season, nearly half of what he managed last year, making it tough to project his ranking heading into 2026.

news.head: Saquon Barkley held to 68 yards in win over Bills
news.body: Saquon Barkley was limited to 68 yards on 19 carries during Sunday's 13-12 win over Buffalo, averaging just 3.6 yards per attempt against a stout defense. The running back saw his three-game scoring streak come to an end and failed to draw a target in the passing game for the first time this season.
news.impact: Despite the modest output, Barkley continued to dominate the backfield usage, handling 19 of Philadelphia's 23 rushing attempts. He carries a season line of 280 carries for 1,140 yards and seven touchdowns into the Week 18 regular-season finale against the Commanders.

news.head: Saquon Barkley goes for 132 yards in win
news.body: Saquon Barkley ran 21 times for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 29-18 win over the Commanders. He failed to corral either of his two targets.
news.impact: Barkley now has a touchdown in three straight games and 100+ rushing yards in two of his last three. This is the Saquon Barkley we thought we would be getting when drafting him, and though it's taken a while, he's showing up at just the right time.

news.head: Cameron Dicker puts just two points on the board in Week 1
news.body: Cameron Dicker did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Widely viewed as one of the best fantasy options among kickers, Dicker was not given much of an opportunity to contribute on Sunday. The Chargers drastically underperformed expectations, totaling only 268 yards of offense and being dominated in time of possession. Dicker will have better games, but this one was a huge disappointment for fantasy managers.

news.head: Cameron Dicker makes lone kick Sunday
news.body: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 19-3 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Dicker was only given one opportunity on Sunday, but he was able to make it and finished with three points in the team's loss to the Broncos. That capped off what was another fantastic season for him, finishing as a top-four kicker in most fantasy league formats and distinguishing himself as one of the league's most consistent kickers in real life.

news.head: Cameron Dicker struggles in loss to Houston
news.body: Cameron Dicker connected on one of his two PATs as well as just one of his two FG attempts in the Chargers' 20-16 loss to the Texans.
news.impact: Dicker's misses were the difference between a Chargers loss and a potential overtime. But it was just not meant to be. He should bounce back next time out with the Chargers, as he's had 10+ kicking points in each of his last three games thanks to the offense that's been rolling.

news.head: Cameron Dicker connects on six kicks Sunday
news.body: Cameron Dicker connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Dicker made field goals from 37 and 27 yards out in the second half. He has made 36-of-38 on the season.

news.head: Travis Kelce solid in win Monday
news.body: Travis Kelce caught 3-of-5 targets for 71 yards in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Kelce wasn't very involved for much of Monday night's game, but he was able to haul in a big catch at one point that helped to leave him with a solid 71 yards on the night. Fantasy managers should be pleased with his performance in this matchup but should not expect him to be a TE1 on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, especially with Kansas City seemingly wanting to operate as a run-heavy team this season.

news.head: Travis Kelce officially re-signs with Chiefs on three-year deal
news.body: The Chiefs re-signed TE Travis Kelce to a three-year, $54.735 million contract.
news.impact: Kelce was reported to have signed a one-year contract, but it is now a three-year deal. He caught 76 passes for 851 yards and five touchdowns last season, and will remain in Kansas City for three more seasons.

news.head: Travis Kelce officially agrees to deal with Chiefs
news.body: Travis Kelce and the Chiefs have now officially agreed to terms on a new deal.
news.impact: It was reported Monday morning and it is now official. Kelce will be returning for a 14th season with Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs.

news.head: Travis Kelce expected to return to Chiefs for 2026 season
news.body: Travis Kelce is expected to return to the Chiefs for a 14th season.
news.impact: Kelce had been deciding on his future with even reports coming out of him potentially signing with another team, but he'll instead return for another year in Kansas City. He hasn't been what he once was production wise the past few seasons, but he has still been very serviceable for the Chiefs. He'll still be on the fantasy radar despite not holding the upside he once had.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. held in check on Sunday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught two of three targets for 21 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.impact: Fannin was held in check on Sunday, along with the rest of the Browns' offense. He will hope for better days next week against the Buccaneers.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (personal) does not practice Friday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. missed practice on Friday for personal reasons.
news.impact: It is not an injury related absence for Fannin. He'll likely be back at practice soon.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. cleared for training camp activities
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) has been cleared to participate in the Browns training camp after undergoing offseason surgery.
news.impact: It turns out Fannin was cleared two weeks ago, it’s just seemingly been kept under wraps. There is much to be decided among the Browns receivers pecking order sharing the field with him, but he should be a favorite to be the Browns top target in the passing game, ala Brock Bowers or Trey McBride-lite.

news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. does not practice Wednesday
news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. did not practice at voluntary OTAs on Wednesday.
news.impact: Fannin was still with the Browns and watching from the sideline. It'll be worth monitoring to see if he returns to practice soon.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins quiet in blowout loss to Jaguars
news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran 12 times for 33 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also caught both of his targets for 17 yards.
news.impact: Judkins was held back by the Browns inept offensive showing, as everyone except Deshaun Watson and Denzel Boston was held under 10 PPR points, and those two got over that because of a bomb touchdown in garbage time. Judkins is the lead back, but his fantasy value is highly questionable unless something changes.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins returns to team drills
news.body: Quinshon Judkins returned to team drills during practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Judkins missed two practices last week and was limited to individual work on Monday. He was back full-go on Tuesday.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins not seen at practice Thursday
news.body: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins was not seen at practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Judkins missed practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue." He remains day-to-day.

news.head: Quinshon Judkins not at practice Wednesday due to 'minor issue'
news.body: The Browns say RB Quinshon Judkins is not at practice on Wednesday due to a "minor issue."
news.impact: It is unclear what Judkins is dealing with specifically. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.

news.head: Rashee Rice finds end zone in win Monday
news.body: Rashee Rice caught two passes for 19 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Rice had an underwhelming game on Monday night. He was held to just two catches for 19 yards against the Broncos, but he was able to get into the end zone on one of those receptions, which helped to salvage his fantasy total. QB Patrick Mahomes II didn't look his way very much in this game, but it seems like the team wanted Mahomes to drop back as little as possible given that it was his first game back from a major knee injury. Rice will likely improve going forward, but fantasy managers should keep a close eye on his production over the next few weeks to gauge whether this poor showing was a fluke or a sign of the things to come for the veteran wideout this season.

news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) active for Week 1
news.body: Rashee Rice (knee) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Rice will suit up after progressing throughout the practice week and not suffering any issues in pregame activities, providing quarterback Patrick Mahomes with all of his pass-catching weapons against the Broncos Monday night.

news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) logs full practice Thursday
news.body: Rashee Rice (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.impact: As expected, Rice was able to log a full practice session on Thursday and seems to be set to play in Monday night's game against the Denver Broncos. Despite the tough matchup, he projects to be a good fantasy option in PPR leagues this week, especially with Patrick Mahomes II (knee) likely to be at the helm for Kansas City.

news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) takes part in 11-on-11 drills Wednesday
news.body: Rashee Rice was able to progress to taking part in 11-on-11 drills at practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Rice has been recovering from arthroscopic surgery on his right knee in May. He was able to participate in 11-on-11 drills for the first time in camp as he continues to progress in the right direction.

news.head: Chris Olave surpasses 180 receiving yards in Week 1 loss to Lions
news.body: Chris Olave hauled in 10 of his team-leading 13 targets for 182 receiving yards in the Saints' 31-30 Week 1 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.impact: Olave capitalized on a dynamic role in the New Orleans passing attack for head coach Kellen Moore, averaging 18.2 yards per reception while leading the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss. The wideout remains a steady WR1 option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens.

news.head: Chris Olave slow to get up Tuesday at practice
news.body: Chris Olave was slow to get up after doing a deep route in practice, landing hard on his back. HC Kellen Moore said that the receiver had the wind knocked out of him, and when asked if there would be further tests or cause for concern, declined to answer.
news.impact: It sounds like Olave should be fine. He shouldn’t suffer any setbacks because of this unless the staff is hiding details. Draft Olave with confidence as the WR1 in an up and coming Saints offense.

news.head: Chris Olave takes part in team drills Friday
news.body: Chris Olave took part in team drills at practice on Friday at Saints training camp.
news.impact: Olave was limited to individual drills earlier in the week. With his extension now out of the way, he'll now fully participate in practices.

news.head: Chris Olave agrees to four-year, $132 million extension with Saints
news.body: Chris Olave has agreed to a four-year, $132 million extension with the New Orleans Saints, including $90 million guaranteed.
news.impact: Olave had a big 2025 season, and it paid off beautifully for the veteran receiver. He’s now locked in for the long haul in a promising situation in New Orleans with a breakout QB in Tyler Shough, and new additions Travis Etienne and Jordyn Tyson.

news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts seven points on the board
news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal try and all four of his PATs in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.impact: Fairbairn showed off his powerful leg in Sunday's loss, nailing a 58-yard attempt to briefly give the Texans a one-point lead in the fourth quarter. The veteran has been kicking for the Texans since 2017 and remains one of the more reliable options in the league.

news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn re-signs with Texans
news.body: The Texans re-signed K Ka'imi Fairbairn to a two-year, $13 million deal.
news.impact: Fairbairn will remain in Houston for two more years. He remains one of the top kickers in the NFL and for fantasy managers.

news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn connects on six field goals in Week 18
news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 6-of-6 field goals in Week 18 against the Colts.
news.impact: Fairbairn finishes the season connecting on 44-of-48 field goals. He should continue to be needed heading into the playoffs.

news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts up 8 kicking points in win
news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made both of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Texans' 20-16 win over the Chargers on Saturday.
news.impact: Fairbairn had a nice game despite the low overall scoring. The Texans' offense is humming this year, and Fairbairn has had fewer than seven kicking points just once all season.

news.head: Mike Evans snags touchdown in 49ers debut
news.body: Mike Evans caught six of seven targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 27-7 blowout win over the Rams on Thursday.
news.impact: Evans had a nice end zone fade touchdown over a Rams DB who was draped all over him, as well as plenty of third-down usage. He's looking like a potential draft-day steal if his momentum keeps up. This is especially true if De'Zhaun Stribling misses extended time with an ankle injury.

news.head: Mike Evans (adductor) returns to practice
news.body: Mike Evans returned to practice Wednesday.
news.impact: Evans was back on the field after being sidelined for most of training camp. He should be good to go for the season opener next week.

news.head: Mike Evans (adductor) hopeful to return to practice next week
news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said he hopes Mike Evans will practice next week.
news.impact: Evans has been absent from practice for much of the past few weeks. He will likely need to log multiple practices early next week to have a good chance of playing in Week 1 against the Rams.

news.head: Mike Evans (groin) planning to play Week 1
news.body: Mike Evans is planning to play in Week 1 as he continues to deal with a groin injury.
news.impact: Evans' groin injury is being described as "minor" after missing back-to-back practices this week. The veteran's status should be monitored leading up to the opening week of the regular season.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. finishes with one grab in season opener
news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught only 1-of-3 targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-14 win over the Chargers.
news.impact: Aside from one big play, Harrison did not make much of a mark for the Cardinals in Sunday's win. Quarterback Jacoby Brissett looked Harrison's way just three times, which was good for only fifth on the team. After finishing well behind fellow wide receivers Kendrick Bourne (8) and Michael Wilson (7) in targets, Harrison might be best viewed as a wait-and-see bench stash for now.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. dealing with cramps
news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Marvin Harrison Jr. was dealing with cramps.
news.impact: Harrison had to stop practicing a couple times on Sunday. It is a positive sign it isn't a leg or hamstring injury he is dealing with.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. expected to play role as X-receiver
news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Marvin Harrison Jr. will play the Davante Adams role as the team’s X-receiver.
news.impact: LaFleur has spent the past three years as the Rams offensive coordinator and figures to bring a lot of what he learned under Sean McVay to the Cardinals offense. This could benefit Harrison's involvement in the red zone the most as we saw from Adams last season in the same spot.

news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. (heel) placed on IR
news.body: The Cardinals placed Marvin Harrison Jr. on injured reserve.
news.impact: Harrison had already been ruled out for Sunday's season finale. He finishes his second season having caught 41 passes for 608 yards and four touchdowns across 12 games.

news.head: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win
news.body: Parker Washington caught five of six targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns.
news.impact: Washington answered the call of all the offseason hype with flying colors. He scored on a 30-yard bomb from Trevor Lawrence early on in the game and kept showing up to make plays afterwards. Expect Washington to continue to be a focal point in the offense, especially if Brian Thomas Jr. were to miss any time.

news.head: Parker Washington, Jaguars remain in contract talks
news.body: The Jacksonville Jaguars are "not going to stop talking" to wide receiver Parker Washington as both sides iron out a potential contract extension, says general manager James Gladstone.
news.impact: Gladstone said the team would not hesitate to carry contract discussions into the regular season as they aim to finalize a deal with their breakout wideout. Washington had 58 receptions for 847 yards and five touchdowns last season and carries an expert consensus ranking of WR29, according to FantasPros, into his fourth NFL season.

news.head: Parker Washington (undisclosed) participating in practice Tuesday
news.body: Parker Washington (undisclosed) is participating in Jacksonville's practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Washington has been battling an undisclosed injury of some kind for a little while now, but he was back and participating at practice on Tuesday. That's a good sign that he is close to full health, especially considering that it was a joint practice with the Buccaneers. He seems to be fully on track to play in Week 1 and remains an intriguing late-round dart throw if healthy.

news.head: Parker Washington (undisclosed) expected to return to practice next week
news.body: Jaguars WR Parker Washington is expected to return to practice next week.
news.impact: Washington was absent from practice on Tuesday due to an undisclosed injury. He should be back on the field next week.

news.head: Jaxson Dart electric in win Sunday
news.body: Jaxson Dart completed 23-of-29 passing attempts for 230 yards and three touchdowns while adding 54 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 28-20 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Dart had a great start to the season on Sunday night. He totaled close to 300 yards and three touchdowns in a big win over the Cowboys, and he didn't lose any turnovers in the process. New York's offense as a whole looked effective with him at the helm, and they will likely continue to look good for the next three or four weeks with a relatively easy schedule coming down the pipe.

news.head: Jaxson Dart focusing on mature scrambling decisions
news.body: Giants QB Jaxson Dart said he won't change competitiveness but is focusing on mature scrambling decisions.
news.impact: Dart suffered multiple concussions last season, in large part due to how often he scrambled and ran the ball. He'll likely attempt to slide sooner when necessary this season. He should still provide plenty of rushing upside for fantasy managers.

news.head: Jaxson Dart finishes rookie season with a solid effort
news.body: Jaxson Dart completed 22 of 32 passes for 230 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions, adding 32 yards on five carries in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Cowboys.
news.impact: Dart wrapped up his rookie campaign with yet another promising performance at the helm of the Giants offense. The former Ole Miss standout has given the Giants plenty of confidence build around him for the future. Over 14 games this season, Dart completed 63.2% of his passes for 2,272 yards and 15-5 TD/INT ratio. He also used his running ability to gain nearly 500 yards and account for another nine touchdowns. Dart is an extremely valuable dynasty or keeper-league piece, and he is sure to have his suitors in 2026 redraft formats as well.

news.head: Jaxson Dart: Giants starters expected to play in Week 18
news.body: Giants interim coach Mike Kafka plans to stick with his usual starters for New York in Week 18 against the Cowboys.
news.impact: Dak Prescott is expected to play, so both teams starters should play in the season finale for both teams. It is a favorable matchup for Dart and the Giants offense to end the season on a high note.

news.head: Kenneth Walker III dominant in win Monday
news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed the ball 23 times for 173 yards and a touchdown while catching 3-of-6 targets for 18 yards and an additional touchdown in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Walker was absolutely dominant in his debut with the Chiefs on Monday night. He totaled 191 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the game, which was especially impressive considering that he did it against one of the best defenses in the NFL in the Broncos. He looks great on his new offense and should be in line for a huge season if he can stay healthy with this increased workload.

news.head: Kenneth Walker III (foot) off injury report for Monday
news.body: Kenneth Walker III (foot) is off of the injury report ahead of Monday night's game against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Walker was previously dealing with a foot injury of some kind, but he is over it now and is no longer listed on the team's injury report ahead of their Week 1 matchup against the Broncos. Fantasy managers should expect him to be highly involved on Monday night, although the tough matchup may hurt his ceiling from a fantasy perspective.

news.head: Kenneth Walker III (foot) not practicing Tuesday
news.body: Kenneth Walker III is not practicing on Tuesday due to a foot injury.
news.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is for Walker. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.head: Kenneth Walker III primed for 'workhorse' role
news.body: Kenneth Walker III is reportedly "primed to be the clear workhorse" in the Chiefs' offense.
news.impact: Walker is currently being selected as a low-end RB1 in fantasy drafts. If the Chiefs rely on him as reported, though, Walker has a strong chance to finish as a top-five RB.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday
news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.

news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down 49ers offense Saturday
news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST held the high-powered 49ers offense to just 173 total yards on Saturday night as Seattle clinched the NFC West and the top seed in the NFC with a 13-3 victory.
news.impact: The Seahawks' defense was swarming all night, limiting the 49ers to just nine first downs and 173 total yards for the game. Seattle sacked Brock Purdy three times and also got a huge interception from Drake Thomas at the Seahawks' three-yard line early in the fourth quarter. San Francisco was 2-of-9 on third downs and averaged only 4.1 yards per play on the night.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Panthers passing attack Sunday
news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 10 points on 139 total yards with two sacks, one interception and one fumble recovery on Sunday.
news.impact: The Seahawks held Tetairoa McMillan to just one catch all game. They allowed one touchdown with the field goal coming on short yardage following a Sam Darnold fumble. They draw a 49ers offense on fire in Week 18 with the division and No. 1 seed on the line.

news.head: Seahawks D/ST struggles Thursday night
news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST struggled on Thursday night, allowing 581 yards of total offense, while not recording a sack and not forcing a turnover during their 38-37 overtime victory.
news.impact: One of fantasy's best defenses during the season, the Seahawks have posted back-to-back low point totals despite two victories. Seattle has forced only one turnover and collected one sack during the two weeks. The Seahawks will look to rebound next Sunday in another crucial matchup at Carolina.

news.head: George Kittle snags two passes in win
news.body: George Kittle caught two of five targets for 12 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 demolition of the Rams on Thursday.
news.impact: Kittle was involved, that's for sure, but his small output won't cut it for fantasy managers who are relying on him. As he continues to ramp up and recover from his Achilles tear, he should see his involvement tick upwards.

news.head: George Kittle off injury report, active for Thursday
news.body: George Kittle is off the 49ers injury report and is active for their game against the Rams in Melbourne.
news.impact: Kittle is a day under nine months since his Achilles tear, and now will complete his improbable comeback by playing in the Niners season opener. Expect him to have a decent workload, though don’t be surprised if the Niners limit his snaps a bit. He’s crucial for their long term success, so they’ll need to keep him fresh and available.

news.head: George Kittle (Achilles) limited again Wednesday
news.body: George Kittle (Achilles) was limited at practice again on Wednesday.
news.impact: The star tight end was once again limited at practice on Wednesday. He seems to have a good chance to play on Thursday night, but he will probably be limited even if active. The team's official injury report should shed more light on his status when it comes out.

news.head: George Kittle (Achilles) limited in practice Tuesday
news.body: George Kittle was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
news.impact: Kittle remains on track to be good to go for Thursday’s season opener coming off an Achilles tear. It is unclear if he'll be facing any sort of snap count on Thursday.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka totals 63 yards Sunday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka caught 5-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
news.impact: Egbuka entered Sunday fully healthy after coming off a toe injury. He got off to a strong start in the first half, but he was not targeted in the second half despite the Bucs trailing. He remains a WR2 heading into Week 2.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) cleared for Week 1
news.body: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is cleared to play in Week 1 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Greg Auman.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) practicing again Friday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka (toe) participates fully in Friday's practice session.
news.impact: It certainly seems that Egbuka will have no limitations for Sunday's season opener against the Bengals. The second-year wideout will lead the Buccaneers' receiving corps for quarterback Baker Mayfield.

news.head: Emeka Egbuka (toe) logs another full practice Thursday
news.body: Emeka Egbuka remained a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.impact: Egbuka has now posted back-to-back full practices, leaving him well on track to be good to go for Week 1. He is an upside WR2 heading into the season and could be part of one of the higher-scoring games of the week on Sunday against the Bengals.

news.head: James Cook III goes for 69 yards in big win over Texans
news.body: James Cook III ran 13 times for 57 yards and caught three of four targets for 12 yards in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.impact: Cook was fine on his touches and was saved by his three receptions in PPR formats, but it fantasy managers will be hoping for more. He’s still a premium running back, and he will get his chance early this week as the Bills play the Lions on Thursday night.

news.head: James Cook will play in preseason opener
news.body: James Cook III and all Bills starters are set to play Saturday, per HC Joe Brady.
news.impact: Cook is reportedly expected to have a larger role as a pass catcher in 2026. Saturday's preseason opener against the Panthers could offer a preview of the Bills' plans for their RB1.

news.head: James Cook III nets two carries in Week 18 win
news.body: James Cook III rushed for 15 yards on two carries in the Bills 35-8 win over the Jets.
news.impact: Cook and the majority of the Bills' starters on offense were used sparingly in the win over the Jets. Cook turned in an excellent season, finishing with 1,621 rushing yards and 12 touchdowns on 309 carries this season. He will remain a highly sought after pick in fantasy drafts in 2026.

news.head: James Cook held in check by Eagles defense
news.body: James Cook rushed 20 times for 74 yards and caught one of his four targets for three yards during Sunday's 13-12 loss to Philadelphia. While the running back reached the 20-carry plateau for the sixth time this season, he was held under 100 rushing yards and averaged less than 4.0 yards per carry for just the fourth time in 2025.
news.impact: Despite the quiet outing, Cook has compiled an impressive season line of 307 carries for 1,606 yards and 12 touchdowns. He will look to finish the regular season strong in a favorable matchup against the Jets in Week 18.

news.head: Juwan Johnson catches touchdown in Week 1 loss
news.body: Juwan Johnson caught three of his seven targets for 54 yards and one touchdown in the Saints' 31-30 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 1.
news.impact: Johnson was impactful as the No. 1 tight end for head coach Kellen Moore, averaging 18.0 yards per reception in the loss. the tight end remains a stable option in all formats with plenty of upside in the New Orleans passing attack moving forward, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

news.head: Juwan Johnson restructures contract with Saints
news.body: The Saints restructured the contract of TE Juwan Johnson.
news.impact: Johnson was one of three players to restructure his contract with the Saints as they look to open cap space. He earned 100 targets last year.

news.head: Juwan Johnson totals 61 yards in Week 18
news.body: Juwan Johnson caught 3-of-5 targets for 61 yards in the Saints 19-17 loss against the Falcons.
news.impact: Johnson led the Saints in receiving in the season finale. He totaled a career-high in yards this year. He should be on the TE1 radar heading into next season.

news.head: Juwan Johnson sets new career high in receiving yards
news.body: Juwan Johnson secured all four of his targets for 95 yards in Sunday's win over the Titans.
news.impact: It was a big-play day for Johnson, as the veteran TE set a new career high with 95 receiving yards. This effort came a week after tying a career best with eight receptions. In his sixth NFL season, Johnson has enjoyed quite a breakout for the Saints.

news.head: Derrick Henry rushes for three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Colts
news.body: Derrick Henry carried the ball 24 times for 144 yards and three touchdowns while also hauling in his lone target for 19 yards in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Henry capitalized on a sizeable workload out of the Baltimore backfield, averaging an impressive 6.0 yards per carry in the Week 1 win. The superstar running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Derrick Henry rushes for 126 yards in Week 18
news.body: Derrick Henry carried the ball 20 times for 126 yards in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Henry was unable to corral his lone target in the contest. With the loss, the Ravens will miss the playoffs in a disappointing ending to the season. Henry finishes the year with 1,595 rushing yards and 16 touchdowns while appearing in all 17 games. He will remain a solid RB1 for fantasy purposes heading into the 2026 season.

news.head: Derrick Henry has historic night against Packers
news.body: Derrick Henry ran 36 times for 216 yards and four touchdowns in the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers on Saturday.
news.impact: Henry's performance could easily be what decides the title for many fantasy championships. His 36 rush attempts were a career high in a single game, and his four touchdowns tied his career high in touchdowns in a game. Henry now has over 1,400 rushing yards and 16 touchdowns this season, a great total. The King is still on the throne.

news.head: Derrick Henry scores two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.body: Derrick Henry rushed the ball 18 times for 128 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday night's 28-24 loss to the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Henry was dominant for most of Sunday night's game, totaling 128 yards and two touchdowns on the ground while maintaining great efficiency at 7.1 yards per carry. He coughed up a costly fumble in the second half and didn't really take the field again after that, however. He will likely continue to be a decent fantasy option over the last couple weeks of the season, though his upside will be limited if Lamar Jackson (back) is sidelined for the Ravens.

news.head: Andy Borregales scores four points Wednesday
news.body: Andy Borregales made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: The young kicker didn't get many opportunities on Wednesday night. He converted both of his attempts, however, leaving him with at least four points on the night. He doesn't project to be a strong option at the position moving forward.

news.head: Andy Borregales misses one kick Sunday
news.body: Andy Borregales went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: Borregales had an up-and-down game on Sunday. He missed one of his field-goal attempts against the Dolphins, but outside of that he made all of his kicks, including a field goal from 59 yards out. He has proven himself to be reliable overall and should remain their starter in 2026.

news.head: Andy Borregales misses lone field goal attempt
news.body: Andy Borregales went 0-for-1 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra points in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.impact: Borregales missed a 41-yard attempt late in the third quarter, his first missed field goal since Week 13. The rookie has been fairly consistent this season and will look to build upon a strong rookie campaign in Week 18.

news.head: Andy Borregales perfect in win Sunday
news.body: Andy Borregales went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made both of his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-24 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.impact: The rookie was perfect on Sunday. He made all four of his kicks en route to a win over the Ravens and finished the game with eight points in total. He should continue to be a decent fantasy option over the last couple games of the season.

news.head: Davante Adams quiet in loss to 49ers
news.body: Davante Adams caught just three of six targets for 26 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers on Thursday.
news.impact: Adams could just not get much going against the Niners. On the bright side, his six targets were second on the team, so he's still earning opportunities. It just wasn't his day, as was the story for most of the team. He will try to improve next time out.

news.head: Davante Adams expected to be back with Rams next season
news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay said he “absolutely” expects to have Davante Adams back next season.
news.impact: Adams has one more year left on his contract as he comes off a year where he led the league in receiving touchdowns. The Rams are expected to run it back with Adams, Puka Nacua and Matthew Stafford after falling just short of the Super Bowl this year.

news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) off injury report
news.body: Davante Adams (hamstring) has been removed from the Rams' injury report.
news.impact: Adams has been fully active at Rams' practice this week and will be ready to go for Saturday's playoff matchup with the Panthers. Adams missed the final three weeks of the regular season after hauling in 60 passes, including a league-leading 14 touchdown grabs, over 14 games.

news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) logs full practice Tuesday
news.body: Davante Adams was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Adams is expected to return in the Wild Card round this weekend. He was estimated as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough.

news.head: Colston Loveland sees two targets in Week 1
news.body: Colston Loveland failed to catch either of his two targets in the Bears' 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.impact: Loveland was non-existent in an explosive Chicago offense for head coach Ben Johnson in the season opener, operating as more of an afterthought in the win. The tight end will look to get back on track in a Week 2 divisional contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.head: Colston Loveland catches 10 passes and scores TD in Week 18
news.body: Colston Loveland caught a team-high 10 passes, on 13 targets, for 91 yards and a score in the Bears' 19-16 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
news.impact: Loveland, the first-round pick out of Michigan, is starting to get hot at the right time for the Bears. Over the last two weeks, the tight end has caught 16 passes for 185 yards and two touchdowns. After a slow start to the season (11 catches in the first six weeks), Loveland has caught 47 passes over his last ten games. He will look to remain a focal point of the offense during the postseason.

news.head: Colston Loveland sees 10 targets in Week 17 loss to 49ers
news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in six of his team-leading 10 targets for 94 yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 42-38 Week 17 loss to the 49ers.
news.impact: Loveland has made the most of modest involvement in the Chicago passing attack of late, recording one touchdown in three of his last six games. The tight end remains a boom-or-bust tight end option in all formats for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 18 matchup against the Detroit Lions.

news.head: Colston Loveland hauls in three receptions in Week 16 win
news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in three of his four targets for 30 yards in the Bears' 22-16 Week 16 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Loveland has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Chicago passing attack, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in five of his last six games. The tight end remains a difficult option for fantasy managers to trust ahead of a Week 17 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (rib) to be monitored this week
news.body: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is dealing a rib injury and he’ll be monitored throughout the week.
news.impact: McConkey was further evaluated on Monday for his injury. His status is uncertain heading into Week 2 against the Raiders.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (rib) undergoing testing
news.body: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey will undergo testing to determine the severity of his rib injury.
news.impact: There should be an update provided on McConkey later this week. He caught five passes for 82 yards and a touchdown before taking an ugly hit on Sunday. His status is uncertain for Week 2 against the Raiders.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exits early Sunday
news.body: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exited early for the Los Angeles Chargers against the Arizona Cardinals Sunday.
news.impact: McConkey headed to the medical tent after suffering an undisclosed injury, hauling in five of his seven targets for 82 yards and one touchdown for head coach Jim Harbaugh.

news.head: Ladd McConkey (hamstring) expects to be "full go" for training camp
news.body: Ladd McConkey said he expects to be "full go" for the entirety of Chargers training camp.
news.impact: McConkey was limited in spring action due to a hamstring injury, but a few months of rest and recovery seem to have been beneficial. The wideout is coming off a bit of a disappointing sophomore campaign after bursting on the scene with 1,149 receiving yards as a rookie. He will look to find more success with Mike McDaniel now calling the plays in LA.

news.head: Garrett Wilson goes for 79 yards in Week 1
news.body: Garrett Wilson caught six of his seven targets for 79 yards in a 23-10 win over the Titans in Week 1.
news.impact: Wilson led the Jets in all receiving categories in the easy win over an overmatched Tennessee team. Even though it wasn't a huge performance from Wilson, it was an encouraging debut for the receiver with Geno Smith at the helm. Wilson settles in as a high-end WR2 in a Week 2 home matchup against the Packers.

news.head: Garrett Wilson (illness) back at practice Tuesday
news.body: Garrett Wilson (illness) was back in action Tuesday after missing Monday's practice.
news.impact: Nothing much to see here for Wilson. The Jets' No. 1 receiver sat out Monday due to being under the weather, but he was back on the practice field Tuesday.

news.head: Garrett Wilson (illness) not at practice Monday
news.body: Garrett Wilson (illness) did not participate in practice on Monday due to an illness.
news.impact: Thankfully, this sort of practice absence is one where it raises little, if any, concern. Wilson will likely return to practice as normal within the next day or so.

news.head: Garrett Wilson (knee) will not return this season
news.body: Jets coach Aaron Glenn said Garrett Wilson will not play for the rest of the season.
news.impact: It comes as no surprise that Wilson will not return for a Jets team that has nothing to play for. He was placed on injured reserve back in the middle of November. He finishes the season having caught 36 passes for 395 yards and four touchdowns.

news.head: Jadarian Price totals 58 yards in NFL debut Wednesday
news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 52 yards and caught two passes for six yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.impact: The rookie had a decent performance in his NFL debut. He rushed for 52 yards at an efficient clip of 5.2 yards per carry, and he saw a bit of involvement in the passing game as well. From a fantasy perspective this was a disappointing game, but he showed promise in this game and will likely perform better in positive matchups moving forward.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) returns to practice
news.body: Seahawks RB jadarian Price returned to full participation in practice.
news.impact: Price is continuing to be eased back into practice. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the season. The question remains what his immediate role will be. He should be the lead back, at least on paper. We'll see if he gets any work in the Seahawks second preseason game.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) goes through walkthrough Wednesday
news.body: Jadarian Price went through a walkthrough in practice on Wednesday.
news.impact: Price makes his return for the first time in five practices. It is a positive sign for the rookie after he has been sidelined the past month.

news.head: Jadarian Price (leg) back in pads at practice Tuesday
news.body: Jadarian Price was back in pads at practice on Tuesday.
news.impact: Price winds up missing just a few days of practice due to a leg injury. The rookie continues to earn his reps with the first-team during training camp.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten racks up 66 yards on the ground in win
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran 15 times for 66 yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also caught his only target for 22 yards.
news.impact: Tuten led the Jags in rushing attempts in the win, but didn't have much to show in terms of fantasy scoring in half- or full-PPR formats. But to be fair, he was efficient in his touches, and it's likely that better days are ahead for the apparent Jags RB1.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten expected to ‘have a big year’ per HC Coen
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten is expected to “have a big year” according to HC Liam Coen. Coen praised the second year back in an interview, noting his explosive ability and the growth in his game.
news.impact: Tuten is the favorite for RB1 duties in Jacksonville with his do-it-all skillset, while Chris Rodriguez dealing with an injury this offseason and LeQuint Allen is primarily a pass blocking and catching specialist. He’s still a bit of an unknown since Travis Etienne handled the majority of backfield work in 2025, but his upside should things work out is tantalizing.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten gets five touches in return
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran five times for 23 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.impact: Tuten didn't touch the ball much in his return to play, but it's important to note that he was the RB2 of the offense, putting LeQuint Allen back in his special teams role.

news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (finger) off injury report for Week 18
news.body: Bhayshul Tuten is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Titans.
news.impact: Tuten is set to return after missing the past two weeks. He should return to his change-of-pace role behind Travis Etienne.

news.head: Quentin Johnston does little in Week 1 loss
news.body: Quentin Johnston came up with only 2-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.impact: Johnston has finished each of the last two seasons with more than 50 grabs, over 700 yards, and exactly eight touchdowns. Some have him pegged to take the next big step up in his fourth season, but some of that hype will be quelled with this season-opening disappointment. The Chargers' offense just had a difficult time getting much going at all in their first game under new OC Mike McDaniel. Johnston should still produce some valuable stats, and he may have just become a nice buy-low option for fantasy purposes.

news.head: Quentin Johnston not expected to miss much time
news.body: Chargers WR Quentin Johnston is not expected to miss much, if any, practice time.
news.impact: Johnston limped off the field during practice on Tuesday. He is day-to-day for now.

news.head: Quentin Johnston suffers apparent lower body injury
news.body: Quentin Johnston left practice early on Tuesday with an apparent lower body injury.
news.impact: Johnston came up limping after an attempting to make a leaping catch on the sideline. There should be an update provided on his official status when available.

news.head: Quentin Johnston has fifth-year option picked up by Chargers
news.body: The Chargers exercised the fifth-year option of Quentin Johnston.
news.impact: Johnston will remain under contract with the Chargers through the 2027 season. He'll remain in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in touchdown in loss Sunday
news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-8 targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.impact: Lamb was technically Dallas' leading receiver on Sunday night, but he did that with just 44 yards over the course of the game. He was able to haul in a touchdown at one point, however, which helped to salvage his fantasy total on the day. He will likely revert to being an elite producer at the position when Dallas' offense as a whole bounces back sometime within the next few weeks.

news.head: CeeDee Lamb has contract restructured by Cowboys
news.body: The Cowboys restructured the contract of WR CeeDee Lamb.
news.impact: Lamb was one of three players who had their contracts restructured to help create a significant amount of capital space for the Cowboys. They are now under the cap heading into free agency. Lamb and George Pickens are expected to run it back with Dak Prescott in the passing game for Dallas.

news.head: CeeDee Lamb catches just one pass in Week 18
news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's loss to the Giants.
news.impact: The Cowboys limited most of their starters' snaps in Week 18, and Lamb was no exception. The four-time Pro-Bowler made his 75th catch of the season Sunday, as he finished the campaign with 1,077 yards and three touchdowns over 14 games.

news.head: CeeDee Lamb sees 10 targets in Week 17 win over Commanders
news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in five of his team-high 10 targets for 46 yards in the Cowboys' 30-23 Week 17 win over the Commanders.
news.impact: Lamb continues a productive stretch in the Dallas passing attack, recording 75 or more receiving yards in four of his last six games. The dynamic wideout remains a reliable WR1 option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 18 matchup against the New York Giants.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson totals 95 yards Wednesday
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball 18 times for 51 yards and caught five passes for 44 yards in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.impact: Stevenson was New England's workhorse running back on Wednesday night with TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) out of the lineup. He ran at an inefficient clip of 2.8 yards per carry on the night, but his fantasy total was saved by the fact that he caught five passes. He will be more efficient than this in the future but will lose passing work to Henderson when he's back, so he will likely continue to be touchdown dependent on a week-to-week basis.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (eye) questionable to return Sunday
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson is questionable to return to Sunday's Divisional Round game against the Texans.
news.impact: Stevenson left the game early with a eye injury. TreVeyon Henderson should see more snaps in the Patriots backfield while he is sidelined.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson dominant in Week 18 win
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed the ball seven times for 131 yards and two touchdowns and caught two passes for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: Stevenson saw just nine touches over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but that was all that he needed. He logged 150+ total yards and three touchdowns against Miami, which left him with a dominant fantasy total in that matchup. He is set to return to New England next season and will continue to be featured in a two-headed backfield with TreVeyon Henderson.

news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson scores twice in Week 17 win
news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 47 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets. He caught all five of his targets for 55 yards and a touchdown.
news.impact: Stevenson found the end zone on a one-yard rush and a 22-yard reception in the first half to help pace the Patriots to a route of the Jets. Stevenson saw less carries than TreVeyon Henderson, but earned more targets in the passing game. Fantasy managers should expect both to continue to split time in Week 18 against Miami.

news.head: Sam LaPorta catches five passes in Week 1 win
news.body: Sam LaPorta caught five of his eight targets for 48 yards in the Lions' 31-30 Week 1 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.impact: LaPorta saw sizeable volume in his return to the lineup for head coach Dan Campbell, joining explosive wideouts Jameson Williams and Amon-Ra St. Brown in finishing with eight or more targets in the win. The tight end remains a stable option in all formats as a primary pass-catching option in the Detroit offense ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.head: Sam LaPorta (hip) off injury report for Sunday
news.body: Sam LaPorta (hip) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
news.impact: LaPorta is now off of the injury report after dealing with a hip injury for the latter part of the preseason. He should be a full go for Week 1 and will remain a startable fantasy option in this matchup and beyond.

news.head: Sam LaPorta (hip) returns to practice Tuesday
news.body: Sam Laporta returned to practice on Tuesday after suffering a hip injury last week.
news.impact: Laporta's hip injury has made his status for Week 1 murky, but his returning to practice this early is a good sign. The tight end will likely be limited as he builds back up, but he could be in line to start the season barring any setbacks.

news.head: Sam LaPorta suffers hip injury, uncertain for Week 1
news.body: Sam LaPorta is currently dealing with a hip injury, and HC Dan Campbell told reporters that the team is uncertain if it will affect his availability for Week 1.
news.impact: LaPorta injured his hip on a hit in practice recently. The team is uncertain about the severity of it at this point and will be giving him a few days off to rest and recover before reevaluating. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to this situation, as he may not be worth drafting at his current ADP if he has to miss one or more games at the start of the regular season.

news.head: Lamar Jackson surpasses 300 passing yards in Week 1 win over Colts
news.body: Lamar Jackson completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 324 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 40 yards, one touchdown, and one lost fumble in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Jackson took advantage of a more explosive offensive playbook from first-year offensive coordinator Declan Doyle, accounting for touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the win. The superstar quarterback remains an elite QB1 option entering a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Lamar Jackson to play without contract extension to begin season
news.body: Lamar Jackson will play without a contract extension to begin the season for the Baltimore Ravens according to Mike Garafolo.
news.impact: Jackson is focused on football entering the 2026-27 season under a new Baltimore Ravens coaching staff, as the superstar quarterback is poised for another elite season behind center barring injury while also offering fantasy managers explosive production as a high-level QB1 in all formats with an intriguing Week 1 contest against the Indianapolis Colts ahead.

news.head: Lamar Jackson will not play in preseason opener
news.body: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Lamar Jackson will not play in the preseason opener on Saturday against the Eagles.
news.impact: Minter said there will be some “established players” not playing Saturday. Jackson should see some reps in the second or third preseason game.

news.head: Lamar Jackson says he played through injuries most of last season
news.body: Lamar Jackson told reporters he played through injuries for much of last season.
news.impact: Jackson suffered a hamstring injury in Week 3 that got worse when he tried to make a move the following week in Kansas City. He wound up missing a few games, but he said he was still playing through injuries even when he returned.

news.head: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
news.body: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

news.head: Cam Little racks up 11 kicking points in win
news.body: Cam Little made all five of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans.
news.impact: Little had a great game with the Jaguars putting up a scoring onslaught against the Titans. He's now put up 10+ kicking points in each of his last five games.

news.head: Cam Little makes all five kicks Sunday
news.body: Cam Little connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Little has connected on 28-of-32 field goals overall. He should be in line for plenty of opportunities in Week 18 against the Titans.

news.head: Cam Little totals ten points Sunday
news.body: Cam Little went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made both of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 34-20 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Little did his job on Sunday, making all six of his kicks in a big win over the Broncos. He should continue to be a good fantasy option over the last couple games of the regular season.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro racks up 9 kicking points in win
news.body: Eddy Pineiro made two of three field goal attempts and all three of his PAT's in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams.
news.impact: Pineiro had a solid game overall, though I'm sure he wishes that he could go back and have another try at the one he missed. As long as he is healthy and active and the Niners' offense keeps this up, he should be just fine for fantasy.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro signs four-year deal with 49ers
news.body: Eddy Pineiro and the San Francisco 49ers have agreed on a four-year, $17 million contract. The deal includes $10 million in guaranteed money.
news.impact: In his first season in the Bay Area, Pineiro finished 28-of-29 on field goal attempts and was 34-of-38 on point after tries. He tied for the league lead in field goal percentage (96.6%) and was 14th in the NFL in points with 118. Pineiro ranks second among active kickers in career field goal percentage (89.7%) as he has converted 139-of-155 field goal attempts in his six-year career. He is as steady as they come among NFL kickers and he should be a safe bet for 100+ points again next season.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro accounts for San Francisco's only points Saturday
news.body: Eddy Pineiro kicked a 48-yard field goal with just over a minute left in the first half to account for San Francisco's only points in its 13-3 loss to Seattle on Saturday.
news.impact: That was the only attempt of the night for Pineiro as Seattle's defense kept the 49ers' offense at bay for a majority of the game. Pineiro has missed only one field goal attempt all season (28-of-29) and he is 34-of-38 on point after attempts. Saturday was the only game this season that Pineiro did not attempt a point after.

news.head: Eddy Pineiro perfect in Week 17
news.body: Eddy Pineiro converted all six of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the 49ers' 42-38 win over the Bears in Week 17.
news.impact: Pineiro continues a productive stretch, logging six or more points in each of his last four games. The kicker will look for more success in a Week 18 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.head: Josh Allen dismantles Houston defense in big win
news.body: Josh Allen completed 20-of-29 passes for 334 yards with two touchdowns with an additional 23 yards and two scores on the ground on six carries in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.impact: Allen was in complete control on Sunday, carving up what should have been a difficult Texans defense on his way to a four touchdown performance. He will have another nice matchup against Detroit on Thursday who just allowed a 30-point game to the Saints.

news.head: Josh Allen won't play Thursday
news.body: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.

news.head: Josh Allen will play in preseason opener
news.body: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
news.impact: Allen and the starters will have an opportunity to knock off any lingering rust while building momentum for the regular season.

news.head: Josh Allen (foot) enters offseason program without any limitations
news.body: Josh Allen said his surgically repaired foot feels good and has no limitations.
news.impact: Allen was present at the start of the Bills offseason program. He underwent foot surgery in the offseason, but he's entering camp fully healthy.

news.head: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.head: Jalen Hurts expected to sit out season finale
news.body: The Eagles are expected to rest QB Jalen Hurts in Week 18 against the Commanders
news.impact: Philadelphia is expected to rest most of its starters in the season finale. Third-year QB Tanner McKee will get the start against a struggling Washington defense and could be a serviceable DFS option. Jalen Hurts will turn his focus to the postseason, while also looking ahead to 2026 as a high-end fantasy QB1.

news.head: Jalen Hurts: Eagles starters uncertain for Week 18
news.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said “we’re still thinking through” whether the team would play their starters in Week 18.
news.impact: The Eagles still have a chance to move up to the No. 2 seed in the NFC in the playoffs. There should be more clarity by Wednesday or Thursday on who will be starting for the Eagles.

news.head: Jalen Hurts struggles in wet conditions, throws 25th TD in win
news.body: Jalen Hurts battled accuracy issues in rainy conditions during Sunday's 13-12 victory over Buffalo, completing just 13 of 27 passes for 110 yards and a touchdown. The dual-threat quarterback added only five rushing yards on three carries, resulting in his lowest scrimmage yardage total through 16 starts this season.
news.impact: Despite the statistical struggles, Hurts avoided a fantasy disaster by connecting with Dallas Goedert for a touchdown in the first quarter—his career-best 25th passing score of the year. He will look to sharpen his play before the playoffs when the Eagles host the Commanders in the Week 18 regular-season finale.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) will be limited this week, hopeful for Denver
news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) will be limited in practice this week, per HC Liam Coen. However, Coen noted that the reciever should be good to go against Denver.
news.impact: It’s great news for fantasy managers who were hoping to see more from BTJ before he exited early in what ended up being a blowout win. Thomas is looking to bounce back after a down sophomore season, but facing Denver while coming off of injury is a much harder task than facing Cleveland’s secondary.

news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) questionable to return
