news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 39 points on 239 total yards with three sacks and one interception.
news.impact: Green Bay held its own early despite still being without Micah Parsons. The Packers draw Geno Smith and the Jets next week.

news.head: Green Bay Packers hire Jonathan Gannon as DC
news.body: The Green Bay Packers are hiring Jonathan Gannon as their new Defensive Coordinator.
news.impact: Gannon was fired after an unsuccessful head coaching tenure in Arizona, but he lands in Green Bay with a promising unit led by Micah Parsons, who looks to return from injury during the middle of the 2026 season if not sooner.

news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST quiet in Week 18
news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST recovered one fumble and had two sacks during Sunday's 16-3 loss to Minnesota.
news.impact: The Packers' defense allowed 363 yards of offense to the Vikings, forcing just one turnover, and collecting only two sacks on the day. Green Bay will return to its regular starting lineup next weekend in the Wild Card round.

news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST struggles to stop Ravens rushing onslaught
news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed a single sack with no turnovers in the Packers' 41-24 loss to the Ravens.
news.impact: The Packers got punished in this game by the Ravens ground attack, surrendering 41 points to the team starting a backup QB who threw for just over 100 yards. It was not their best moment, and even though they are down some players, including star Micah Parsons, they can not let games like this happen and expect to make a deep playoff run.

news.head: Buccaneers D/ST put in tough spot Sunday
news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 26 points on 351 total yards with one interception and one sack on Sunday against the Bengals.
news.impact: Cincinnati scored 33 points, but one of them was off a fumble by Baker Mayfield returned for a touchdown. The Bengals also scored 17 other points off Bucs fumbles. The Bucs will be on the streaming radar in Week 2 against the Browns.

news.head: Buccaneers D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.body: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 14 points on 285 total yards with one interception and two fumble recoveries in Week 18 against the Panthers.
news.impact: While the Bucs secondary struggled most of the season, they held their own to close the season while also completely shutting down the Panthers rushing attack. The Bucs also recovered a pair of fumbles and added an interception.

news.head: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST struggles Sunday against Dolphins
news.body: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST failed to come up with any big plays on Sunday against Quinn Ewers and the Dolphins' offense on Sunday. Tampa Bay fell 20-17 to Miami, its seventh loss in the last eight games.
news.impact: The Buccaneers allowed only 298 yards of total offense and kept the Dolphins to just 4-of-12 on third-down conversions, but they failed to force a turnover and only sacked Ewers twice in the game. It's the second straight game the Buccaneers have not forced a turnover and they have only four in the last six games after registering 16 in their first 10 games. Tampa Bay has a chance for redemption when it hosts Carolina for the NFC South title on Saturday.

news.head: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST quiet against Carolina
news.body: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST managed two sacks with no turnovers in the Bucs' 23-20 loss to Carolina on Sunday.
news.impact: The Bucs defense was quiet in this game aside from two sacks. To their credit, they played decently well against the surging Panthers, but fantasy managers would have loved to see more from them. They should be a good start next week against Quinn Ewers and the Dolphins.

news.head: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.head: Evan McPherson shut out in loss
news.body: Evan McPherson failed to hit either of his PATs in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson's failed PATs put the Bengals on the backfoot, forcing them to take a 2-PT conversion attempt that ultimately failed. He's been solid and actually finished with the best FGM % of his career. He should be a good bet for fantasy relevance next season.

news.head: Evan McPherson makes all but one kick Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson made his lone field goal and 4-of-5 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: McPherson made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. He did miss one extra point attempt, but it did not matter in the blowout win for the Bengals.

news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in win Sunday
news.body: Evan McPherson went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.impact: McPherson made all seven of his kicks against the Dolphins, six of which were extra points. He should continue to be a decent fantasy option at the kicker position over the last couple games of the season.

news.head: Cairo Santos perfect in Week 1
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only field goal attempt as well as all eight of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in the Bears' 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
news.impact: Santos benefited from a high-octane Chicago offensive attack, finishing with double-digit points in the win. The veteran kicker should continue to see plenty of opportunities as the season moves forward for fantasy managers, with a Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.head: Cairo Santos held off the scoresheet in Week 18
news.body: Cairo Santos did not attempt a field goal or an extra point in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Lions.
news.impact: It was the only time all season that Santos was kept scoreless as the Bears went for two on both of their touchdowns. Santos went 25-of-30 on field goal attempts and 39-of-39 on point after tries during the regular season.

news.head: Cairo Santos perfect in Week 17
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only field goal attempt as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with eight points in a 42-38 loss to the 49ers in Week 17.
news.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch, recording seven or more points in six of his last seven games. The kicker remains a stable option in all formats ahead of a Week 18 contest against the Detroit Lions.

news.head: Cairo Santos racks up 10 points in Week 16
news.body: Cairo Santos converted his only extra point attempt as well as all three of his field goal attempts to finish with 10 points in the Bears' 22-16 win over the Packers in Week 16.
news.impact: Santos continues a productive stretch in the Chicago offense, finishing with seven or more points in five of his last six games. The kicker remains a mostly reliable option in kicker formats ahead of a Week 17 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.head: Trey Smack nails two deep field goals Sunday
news.body: Trey Smack went 3-for-3 on field goal attempts and 1-for-2 on extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Smack nailed field goals from 59, 43 and 26 yards out. The Packers have found a kicker they can rely on.

news.head: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win
news.body: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.head: Tyler Loop misses potential game-winning FG in Week 18
news.body: Tyler Loop made one of his two field goals and all three of his extra points in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.impact: Loop hit a 40-yard field goal but he missed a potential game-winning 44-yard attempt with two seconds left in the fourth quarter. It was a costly miss as the Ravens' loss gave the Steelers the AFC North title and caused Baltimore to miss the playoffs. Overall, it was a strong rookie season for Loop, who hit 30 of his 34 attempts and missed just two of his 46 extra points.

news.head: Tyler Loop busy in win over Green Bay
news.body: Tyler Loop made all five of his PATs and both of his FG attempts in the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers.
news.impact: Loop had 11 kicking points in this game, as many as he had in his previous two games combined. He should be a decent play next week for fantasy for those who need him.

news.head: Tyler Loop misses kick in loss Sunday
news.body: Tyler Loop went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the New England Patriots.
news.impact: Loop left three points out on the field by missing one of his two field-goal attempts against the Patriots. They ended up losing the game by four points, however, so his miss isn't what secured the loss for them. He doesn't project to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in win Monday
news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Butker did his job on Monday night, hitting all five of his kicks in the team's big win over the Broncos. He didn't end up with a good total from a fantasy perspective, but he should still be considered one of the better fantasy options at his position moving forward.

news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 18 loss
news.body: Harrison Butker connected on 4-of-4 field goals in the Chiefs 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.impact: Butker connected on field goals from 36, 40, 41, and 47 to account for all of the scoring for the Chiefs Sunday. The veteran kicker remains under contract with the Chiefs for 2026 and should remain one of the top options at the position for fantasy managers.

news.head: Harrison Butker puts seven points on the board Thursday
news.body: Harrison Butker made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Thursday's 20-13 loss to the Broncos.
news.impact: Butker took advantage of all his opportunities Thursday, but he simply was not given too many. The veteran kicker has now made 29 of 34 FG attempts with a long of 59 yards over 16 games this season.

news.head: Harrison Butker connects on three field goals Sunday
news.body: Harrison Butker made 3-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.impact: Butker made field goals from 54, 41 and 27 yards out. He missed one from 51 yards out. He is off the fantasy radar in the current state of the Chiefs offense.
